evidence: Static feasibility and ambiguity review of the assigned instruction row, not runtime clearance. All frozen task/rule files were independently SHA256-compared with manifest inputs: zero mismatches. Path citations below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r3/task. instruction.md:3 directs the builder to all six shipped notes; instruction.md:5 specifies /app, / and no sign-in. environment/instructions/integration.md:3,5,7,9 provides the precise Node entry, port, health path, shared persistence and absolute DB_PATH contract; environment/Dockerfile:1-12 supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 and copies the actual notes/empty seed. task.toml enables public network. No external account, inaccessible seed record or service credential is needed. ui.md:3 explicitly allows parser/formatter libraries and keyboard plumbing while reserving the document model to the implementer; ui.md:5-15 defines logical-line, grapheme, multi-caret, undo, literal search, token-treatment and two-space formatting outcomes. These are implementable with browser DOM/canvas/SVG, Intl.Segmenter, parser/formatter libraries and an application-owned undo model; focused reference source confirms these implementation resources are present (custom-editor.js:1-9,73-89,892-904). behaviour.md:3,5 explicitly distinguishes JS/HTML execution, original-source line numbers, five-second pending-work budget, fresh interaction budget and permitted static rollback. security.md:3,5 separates unrestricted app assets from forbidden preview networking/dynamic execution and expressly preserves harmless strings/comments; sandbox/CSP plus parsing/instrumentation is a reachable implementation strategy (runtime.ts:30,51,139-140,372-389). behaviour.md:7,9 makes stale save/restore, read-only history and idempotent retry obligations explicit; SQLite revision guards and restore-operation identity can implement these without an external service (server.js:53-62,95-116). Adversarial reasoning: a localStorage-only app with a successful-looking Save fails the explicit independent-context/server/restart promises; a blanket forbidden-word regex fails the harmless-text exception. A conforming canvas or SVG editor, alternate route/schema, different palette/error wording, small keyboard input or static restored picture remains permitted by ui.md:3,13, behaviour.md:5 and policy.md:3-5; relevant judges use these same allowances rather than forcing the reference's DOM selectors. No material competing interpretation or unreachable requirement identified. The Internal Quality Checks row's historical 'no network' annotation is superseded by the authoritative Quality Checks row's public-internet wording, supplied skill profile and current review policy. raw-evidence-index.json was absent when checked; no runtime, full configured judge, Oracle or model result is claimed. Those separate required measurements must remain unresolved in their owning rows and reconciliation, but are not evidence of an ambiguous or unreachable public requirement in row 6.
